278987956.description:
Natural Quartz Geode
White Druzy Crystal, Beige Stone Matrix
Natural Specimen, Large Display Size
Large natural quartz geode specimen featuring a hollow interior lined with sparkling white druzy crystal clusters. This impressive stone display piece showcases the contrast between the rough exterior matrix and the brilliant crystal formations within. Geodes of this size and clarity are prized as decorative accents and focal points for natural history collections.
Interior cavity filled with dense, sparkling white druzy quartz crystals
Natural tan and beige exterior stone matrix with textured surface
Substantial display size measuring approximately 13.25 inches in length
Natural formation with hollow core and crystalline lining
Condition:
Natural specimen in excellent condition. Crystals are bright and intact with high light refraction. Exterior stone matrix is structurally sound with no major cracks. Surface is clean with natural variations present as expected in an authentic mineral formation.
